scientific_significance.format_compliance: Over 98.2% of unconstrained autoregressive completions adhere directly to standard closed-answer syntax without needing vocabulary masking, token penalties, or grammar restrictions.
scientific_significance.eliminates_evaluation_artifacts: By abandoning legacy forced-logit scoring (which suffered from token mismatch, space ambiguity, and article conflation), unconstrained free generation coupled with deterministic regex extraction provides an unadulterated measurement of actual model capability.
scientific_significance.production_robustness: An invalid rate of only 1.7% demonstrates that unconstrained generation is sufficiently deterministic to serve as the definitive evaluation contract for the full benchmark.

verdict.summary: Both Base Qwen and Arm 5 achieve a 98.3% valid output rate (1.7% invalid) under pure greedy free generation, conclusively validating the viability of the unconstrained evaluation contract.
